en: Because you seemed to want it.

en: Even I don't have enough power yet.
I have to get back what I lost.

en: Oh well. I'll come back another time...

en: In time, you will have to choose.
At that time, which one you will choose

en: I have long looked at people through gold,
and seen the true nature of many.
So I fancy I have an eye for people.
So I am quick to grasp the truth.
But I will do nothing. I am a sick man.
That is all that matters to me now.
If this body could last long,
I would even make a pact with the devil.
I cling to life, you know.

note: trails off; resumed by #1636 (no used_in, placement inferred)

en: It is because of your eyes.
note: no used_in; read as the reason Daedalus gives after #1635
